scope: 0119 part on the HyperMesh 0.5 mm voxel HEX8 (centre-inside filtered), flash reading A' with grouped flashes -- FAST variant, mechanics on the pyamg GPU V-cycle of 0119-flash-voxel.json (fewer laser-off substeps, mechanics-aligned outputs) -- frozen-scaling variant (BUG_FIX.md section 11)
purpose: Same case and solver as 0119-flash-voxel-fast-pyamg.json with ONE change: mechanics scale_policy = frozen, i.e. a reused AMG hierarchy keeps the Jacobi scaling it was built with instead of rescaling every tangent by its current diagonal. Offline replay of real tangent-drift series: reused solves 63 -> 49 iterations at layer 20, 127 -> 78 at layer 30, for free. This config validates it in the heavy-degradation regime (layers 41+), with E0 (v159_voxel_pyamg_fix2, scale_policy current) as the reference arm.

mesh.note: HyperMesh voxel lattice 0.5 mm (mode 3) filtered to centre-inside voxels (convert_hm_voxel.py), rotated to +Z, raft = 2 voxel layers

layer_schedule.activation_rule: activate a 0.5 mm slab when its first flash starts; 5 flashes per slab, each carrying 2.5 real (40 um) layers of energy and clock (12.5 real layers per slab)
layer_schedule.flash_grouping: energy per flash per cell mass = validated 0.2 mm reading

scan.scan_time_rule: t_scan(layer) = A(slab) / (hatch x speed): full-area hatching, contours and jumps excluded

flash.power_rule: commanded(layer) = P x t_scan(layer) / (t_flash x capture(slab))
flash.note: reading A' (D-V2-11): the whole physical layer's energy P x t_scan is flashed in the cell dwell time 0.2 mm / 650 mm/s, then laser-off hold sub-steps span the rest of t_scan. The legacy Gaussian exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) with r = 1 m over a 96 mm part drops 1.0 % centre-to-corner; capture(slab) is evaluated on the mesh (sum over the slab's cells of A_cell x exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) x 2/(pi r^2)), so deposited energy per layer equals Ac x P x t_scan(layer) by construction and the ledger measures it.

thermal_mechanical.release_rule: raft cells cut (stiffness and locked-in stress removed) + 3-point rigid-body anchors on printed nodes; bottom Dirichlet temperature held at the preheat value through cooldown

runner.heat_source_note: depth band re-derived for 0.5 mm cells under the vertex rule: cutoff 499 um (< slab), d = 314.182 um, discrete band integral 1.000000

mechanics.note: 13 rows per flash (2 flash + 6 hold + 5 recoat); one mechanics solve per flash = 5 per 0.5 mm slab

linear_solver.note: MODE=5 pyamg-gpu lane. Thermal: jax CG + Jacobi with the relative residual guard (as hybrid). Mechanics: pyamg smoothed aggregation on the Jacobi-scaled free block with rigid-body near-nullspace (hierarchy built on the CPU once per activation pattern, max_coarse in dofs, the 3x-fresh staleness rule is OFF via rebuild_iter_factor=0 and maxiter=800 since BUG_FIX.md 9.2 -- the 2026-09-15 full-height run rebuilt the hierarchy 745 times in 129 layers, 445 of them from that rule, and froze at the device-memory cap), V-cycle + PCG on the GPU; rebuild-once then PARDISO fallback on a stall; raft-release solve routed to PARDISO by the prefer_direct marker. verbose=true logs every solve (iterations, residual, hierarchy fresh/reused) for the full-height audit. shape_mode=full (BUG_FIX.md 2026-09-14): the jit shapes are the whole mesh for the entire build -- the 2026-09-07 run used the free-block shapes, accumulated ~186 MB host RSS per new activation shape (153 shapes ~ 28 GB) and froze against the 40 GB WSL cap at step 9907; full shape costs ~+24% CG time and compiles once. Build stresses are no longer bit-identical to the PARDISO lane (same equations, different rounding): re-baseline the 40-slab shakedown before comparing. Pinned 2026-09-23: explicit pre-change values (thermal jit false; pyamg scale_policy where absent) so this config reproduces its runs after the defaults moved to the E0j settings.
